description: This Java source file defines the 'Daemon' class in the OpenMRS API, responsible for executing certain tasks with elevated privileges, managing daemon threads, and starting modules with special context. It includes methods for running code in daemon threads, handling session contexts, and managing user privileges, primarily used for background or startup tasks within the OpenMRS system.

classes.name: Daemon
classes.description: Final class providing static methods for executing tasks with elevated privileges, managing daemon threads, starting modules, creating users, and handling session contexts for background or system-level operations within OpenMRS.

classes.name: Daemon.DaemonThread
classes.description: Protected static inner class extending Thread, used to run tasks within daemon threads while capturing return objects and exceptions for managing execution flow.

methods.name: startModule
methods.description: Starts a given module, optionally refreshing the application context, executing within a daemon thread to provide elevated privileges.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description: Creates a new user in the system, ensuring it is called only from allowed classes, and executes in a daemon thread to handle privilege escalation.

methods.name: executeScheduledTask
methods.description: Runs a scheduled task within a daemon thread, restricted to timer scheduler contexts, ensuring privileged execution.

methods.name: runInNewDaemonThread
methods.description: Deprecated method that runs a Runnable in a new daemon thread, enforcing that only existing daemon threads can spawn such threads.

methods.name: runInDaemonThread
methods.description: Runs a Callable or Runnable in a daemon thread, utilizing thread pools, with privilege escalation.

methods.name: runInDaemonThreadWithoutResult
methods.description: Runs a Runnable in a daemon thread without waiting for a result, with security check.

methods.name: runInDaemonThreadAndWait
methods.description: Runs a Runnable in a daemon thread and waits synchronously for its completion.

methods.name: isDaemonThread
methods.description: Checks if the current thread was spawned as a daemon thread by this class or is a recognized WebDaemon.

methods.name: runStartupForService
methods.description: Executes the onStartup() method of an OpenmrsService implementing class as a daemon.

methods.name: getDaemonThreadUser
methods.description: Returns the User object associated with the current daemon thread, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: isDaemonUser
methods.description: Checks if a given User object has the UUID associated with the daemon user.
